1.w: By David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, causing the king to send him away. I will praise the Lord at all times; my mouth will continually praise him.

2.w: I will boast in the Lord; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

3.w: Magnify the Lord with me. Let us praise his name together.

4.w: I sought the Lord’s help and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

5.w: Look to him and be radiant; do not let your faces be ashamed.

6.w: This oppressed man cried out and the Lord heard; he saved him from all his troubles.

7.w: The angel of the Lord camps around the Lord’s loyal followers and delivers them.

8.w: Taste and see that the Lord is good. How blessed is the one who takes shelter in him.

9.w: Fear the Lord, you chosen people of his, for those who fear him lack nothing.

10.w: Even young lions sometimes lack food and are hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

11.w: Come children. Listen to me. I will teach you what it means to fear the Lord.

12.w: Do you want to really live? Would you love to live a long, happy life?

13.w: Then make sure you don’t speak evil words or use deceptive speech.

14.w: Turn away from evil and do what is right. Strive for peace and promote it.

15.w: The Lord pays attention to the godly and hears their cry for help.

16.w: But the Lord opposes evildoers and wipes out all memory of them from the earth.

17.w: The godly cry out and the Lord hears; he saves them from all their troubles.

18.w: The Lord is near the brokenhearted; he delivers those who are discouraged.

19.w: The godly face many dangers, but the Lord saves them from each one of them.

20.w: He protects all his bones; not one of them is broken.

21.w: Evil people self-destruct; those who hate the godly are punished.

22.w: The Lord rescues his servants; all who take shelter in him escape punishment.
